definitions.short: a Cushite , or descendant of Cush
definitions.full: H3569. Kushi I. כּוּשִׁי adjective, of a people of I. כּוּשׁ ; — masculine כּוּשִׁי Jer 13:23 13 t.; feminine כֻּשִׁית Num 12:1 (twice in verse); plural כּוּשִׁים Zeph 2:12 6 t.; כֻּשִֿׁים Dan 11:43 ; כֻּשִׁיִּים Amos 9:7 ; — a. singular agreeing with noun Num 12:1 (twice in verse) (E; only here feminine). b. = substantive, a Cushite Jer 13:23 . c. id. with article, the Cushite , of Joab's adjutant 2Sam 18:21 (twice in verse) (where read ׳חַכּ , for ׳כ ᵑ0 , We Dr Kit Bu), 18:22 ; 18:23 ; 18:31 ; 18:31 ; 18:32 ; 18:32 ; in apposition with proper name Jer 38:7 , 10 , 12 ; 39:16 ; 2Chr 14:8 . d. plural כּוּשִׁים ( הַ ) = substantive Zeph 2:12 ; 2Chr 12:3 ; 14:11 (twice in verse); 14:12 ; 16:8 ; 21:16 ; so כֻּשִֿׁים Dan 11:43 , כֻּשִׁיִּים (si vera lectio) Amos 9:7 .
